body:
# Early Elytra Crafting
[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Datapack/Mod-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/early-craftable-elytra)[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Andy71_Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/ETzFRjAFSZ)

## Overview

In this custom crafting recipe, obtaining an **Elytra** becomes much easier and more accessible for players who want to enjoy **flying** earlier in their Minecraft adventures. Instead of traveling to **End Cities** and searching for rare treasure ships, players can craft an **Elytra** using materials that are challenging but still reasonably obtainable in normal gameplay.

## Crafting Recipe

The recipe is designed to feel **balanced** while remaining simple. It uses **4 Phantom Membranes**, **1 Iron Ingot**, and **2 Feathers** arranged in a crafting table. The **Phantom Membranes** represent the lightweight, wing-like structure of the Elytra, while the **Feathers** reinforce its connection to flight. The **Iron Ingot** provides structural support, making the recipe feel valuable without requiring rare late-game resources.

Players can gather **Phantom Membranes** by defeating **Phantoms** at night, collect **Feathers** from chickens, and obtain an **Iron Ingot** through normal mining and smelting. This makes the recipe accessible while still encouraging players to explore different aspects of survival gameplay.

## Why Use This Mod?

This easy Elytra recipe is perfect for **survival worlds**, **multiplayer servers**, and **modpacks** that aim to reduce the difficulty of obtaining flight. It allows players to focus more on **building**, **exploring**, and **traveling** across vast distances rather than spending large amounts of time searching the **End dimension** for a single item.

At the same time, the required materials ensure that crafting an **Elytra** still feels **rewarding** and valuable.

## Features

* Craft an **Elytra** without visiting **End Cities**
* Uses **4 Phantom Membranes**, **1 Iron Ingot**, and **2 Feathers**
* **Balanced** and survival-friendly recipe
* Uses easily obtainable **vanilla materials**
* Compatible with most **modpacks**
* Makes **early flight progression** more accessible

## Gameplay Impact

The recipe maintains the excitement of unlocking **flight** while making the experience more accessible to casual players. Once crafted, the **Elytra** functions exactly like the vanilla item, allowing players to **glide through the sky**, perform **aerial maneuvers**, and combine it with **Firework Rockets** for fast transportation.

## Conclusion

**Easy Elytra Crafting** provides a simple and practical alternative to the traditional method of obtaining an **Elytra**. Whether you're playing **single-player**, with **friends**, or building a custom **modpack**, this recipe offers a convenient way to unlock one of Minecraft's most enjoyable forms of travel.
